examples.en: I do my homework after dinner.
We play sports after school.
Let's meet after the class.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 after 太阳落山后 after school 的活动。

examples.en: Don't be late for school.
Sorry, I'm late for the class.
He often goes to bed late.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 late 闹钟响晚了，匆匆忙忙赶上学。

examples.en: My pen pal lives in Spain.
Spain is famous for football.
She wants to visit Spain one day.
examples.zh: 她想有一天去西班牙看看。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：Spain 音近「西班」，Spain 就是西班牙。
语义联想：My pen pal is from Spain. Spain 是西班牙。

examples.en: We start school at eight o'clock.
When does the dancing class start?
Let's start our work now.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：School starts at eight. start 是开始、着手。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 starts；过去式 started

examples.en: I usually get up at seven.
She usually takes a dancing class on Saturday.
examples.zh: 她通常星期六上舞蹈课。

examples.en: We usually have lunch at school.
examples.zh: 我们通常在学校吃午饭。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：usual 通常 + ly，usually 是通常、平常。

examples.en: When do you usually get up?
When does your class start?
When is your dancing class?
examples.zh: 你的舞蹈课是什么时候？

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 when 钟表指针指向问「什么时候」。

examples.en: School starts at eight a.m.
examples.zh: 学校上午八点钟开始上课。

examples.en: I get up at six thirty a.m.
The shop opens at nine a.m.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：a.m. = ante meridiem，拉丁语「午前」，a.m. 是上午。

examples.en: We do morning exercises at school.
Let's do morning exercises together.
I do morning exercises before breakfast.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：do 做 + morning exercises 早操，合起来是做早操。

examples.en: I usually eat breakfast at seven o'clock.
Don't skip breakfast before school.
We eat breakfast together on weekends.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：eat 吃 + breakfast 早餐，eat breakfast 是吃早饭。

examples.en: We eat dinner at six in the evening.
examples.zh: 我们晚上六点钟吃晚饭。

examples.en: I help my mum before we eat dinner.
examples.zh: 吃晚饭前我帮妈妈干活。

examples.en: Don't eat dinner too late.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：eat 吃 + dinner 晚餐，eat dinner 是吃晚饭。

examples.en: Morning exercise is good for you.
We do exercise in the playground.
Take more exercise and you will feel better.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ex 向外 + ercise，exercise 是活动、运动、锻炼。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 exercises；过去式 exercised

examples.en: I have an English class on Monday.
She has a dancing class after school.
When do you have art class?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：have 有/上 + class 课，have … class 是上……课。

examples.en: We eat dinner at six p.m.
examples.zh: 我们下午六点钟吃晚饭。

examples.en: The class ends at four p.m.
I do my homework at seven p.m.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：p.m. = post meridiem，拉丁语「午后」，p.m. 是下午。

examples.en: We play sports after school every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天放学后做体育运动。

examples.en: Do you like to play sports?
Playing sports keeps us healthy.
examples.zh: 做体育运动让我们保持健康。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：play 进行 + sports 运动，play sports 是做体育运动。

examples.en: I like dancing, and I also like singing.
examples.zh: 我喜欢跳舞，也喜欢唱歌。

examples.en: She can play the piano and also dance well.
examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴，舞也跳得好。

examples.en: We also need to finish our homework.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I like dancing, and I also like singing. also 是还、也。

examples.en: I'm very busy on weekdays.
My mum is busy at work today.
Don't call me when I'm busy.
examples.zh: 我忙的时候别给我打电话。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 busy 日程表上排满舞蹈课和作业。

examples.en: I was busy last weekend.
We had a dancing show last Friday.
examples.zh: 我们上星期五有舞蹈表演。

examples.en: Last night I went to bed late.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I was busy last weekend. last 是上一个、刚过去的。

examples.en: I need to take a dancing class.
We need more time for our work.
examples.zh: 我们需要更多时间做功课。

examples.en: Do you need any help?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I need to take a class. need 是需要。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 needs；过去式 needed

examples.en: I shop with my mum on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我星期六和妈妈一起购物。

examples.en: Let's shop for a new coat.
examples.zh: 我们去买一件新大衣吧。

examples.en: We shop at the mall on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们星期五去商场购物。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：shop 音近「商店」，去 shop 就是去商店买东西。
形象联想：想象 shop 和妈妈一起推购物车购物。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 shops；过去式 shopped

examples.en: That sound is very loud.
I hear a strange sound.
examples.zh: 我听到一个奇怪的声音。

examples.en: The sound of rain is nice.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：That sounds fun. sound 是听起来、好像。

examples.en: Why are you so busy today?
Why do you like dancing?
Why is he late again?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Why are you so busy? why 是为什么。

examples.en: I work hard at school.
She has a lot of work to do.
Let's work together on this project.
examples.zh: 我们一起做这个项目吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I work hard at school. work 是工作、劳动；努力。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 works；过去式 worked

examples.en: I clean my room on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我星期六打扫我的房间。

examples.en: Please clean your room before you go out.
examples.zh: 出门前请打扫你的房间。

examples.en: She cleans her room every week.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：clean 打扫 + my room 我的房间，clean my room 是打扫房间。

examples.en: My hobby is dancing.
She is good at dancing.
We have a dancing show on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们星期五有舞蹈表演。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：dance 跳舞 + ing，dancing 是正在跳舞、舞蹈。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 dance；dancing 表示正在跳舞

examples.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
My grandpa goes for a walk every morning.
We went for a walk in the park.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + for a walk 散步，go for a walk 是散步。

examples.en: I go shopping with my mum on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我星期天和妈妈一起去购物。

examples.en: Let's go shopping after school.
She likes to go shopping on weekends.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + shopping 购物，go shopping 是去买东西。

examples.en: I take a dancing class on Mondays.
She will take an English class after school.
examples.zh: 她放学后会上一节英语课。

examples.en: Do you take any art classes?

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 take a class 背着书包走进教室上课。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 takes；过去式 took

examples.en: I take a dancing class on Wednesdays.
She takes a dancing class after school.
Do you take a dancing class too?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：take 上 + a dancing class 舞蹈课，take a dancing class 是上舞蹈课。

examples.en: She always works hard at school.
I always take my dancing shoes with me.
He is always late for class.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：all 全部 + ways 方式，always 是总是、一直。

examples.en: The boy found a cave on the island.
examples.zh: 男孩在岛上发现了一个洞穴。

examples.en: They stayed in the cave for one night.
examples.zh: 他们在洞穴里待了一晚。

examples.en: The cave is dark and quiet.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cave 音近「开夫」，开夫在 cave 洞穴里探险。
形象联想：想象 cave 黑暗的洞穴里点着火把。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 caves

examples.en: We go swimming in summer.
Let's go swimming this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午我们去游泳吧。

examples.en: He goes swimming every weekend.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + swimming 游泳，go swimming 是去游泳。

examples.en: Robinson lived on an island.
The island is far from the city.
We took a boat to the island.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：is 是 + land 陆地，island 是岛屿、陆地。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 islands

examples.en: I write a letter to my pen pal in Spain.
examples.zh: 我给西班牙的笔友写信。

examples.en: Please read this letter carefully.
She got a letter from her friend yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天收到朋友的一封信。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：letter 音近「来特」，来信特别就是 letter。
语义联想：I write a letter to my pen pal. letter 是信；字母。

examples.en: I live in Beijing with my family.
Where do you live?
They live on a small island.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 live 一家人住在海边的小岛上。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 lives；过去式 lived

examples.en: We will put on a play next month.
examples.zh: 我们下个月要演一出戏。

examples.en: She wrote a short play for our class.
examples.zh: 她为班级写了一个短剧本。

examples.en: The play is about a boy on an island.
examples.zh: 这出戏讲的是一个岛上的男孩。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 play 舞台上演员们排演一出戏剧。

examples.en: She wants to win the dancing contest.
Work hard and you can win.
I hope we win the game.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our team won the game. win 是获胜、赢。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wins；过去式 won

examples.en: Autumn is my favourite season. I like it best.
examples.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，我最喜欢它。

examples.en: Which season do you like best?
She is the best at painting in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我们班画画最好的。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 best 季节排行榜上秋天排在第一。

examples.en: I like snow in winter.
The snow is white and soft.
We can make a snowman after the snow.
examples.zh: 下雪后我们可以堆雪人。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：snow 音近「斯诺」，下雪像铺了一层斯诺。
形象联想：想象 snow 白茫茫的雪地上堆雪人。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 snows；过去式 snowed

examples.en: Which season do you like best?
Which coat is yours?
Which month is your birthday in?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：which 音近「威奇」，威奇哪一个？which 就是哪一个。
语义联想：Which season do you like best? which 是哪一个。

examples.en: Autumn is cool and beautiful.
Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
We pick apples in autumn.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：autumn 与 harvest 相关，autumn 是秋天。

examples.en: Spring is a season I like.
Which season do you like?
Every season is beautiful.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：season 音近「西森」，一年西森四个 season 季节。
形象联想：想象 season 春夏秋冬四个季节轮替。

examples.en: Spring is warm and green.
Flowers bloom in spring.
I like spring best.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：spring 本义跳跃、萌发，spring 是春天。

examples.en: Summer is hot and sunny.
We go swimming in summer.
School ends in summer.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sum 顶 + mer，summer 是夏天。

examples.en: Winter is cold and snowy.
We make a snowman in winter.
I wear a warm coat in winter.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：win 冷 + ter，winter 是冬天。

examples.en: I like winter because I can play in the snow.
examples.zh: 我喜欢冬天，因为我可以在雪里玩。

examples.en: She stays at home because it is snowing.
examples.zh: 她待在家里，因为正在下雪。

examples.en: We paint trees because autumn is beautiful.
examples.zh: 我们画树，因为秋天很美。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：be 因为 + cause 原因，because 是因为。

examples.en: Good job! You finished on time.
The teacher said, "Good job!"
Good job on your painting.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：good 好 + job 工作/表现，good job 是做得好。

examples.en: We have a winter vacation in January.
Where did you go on your vacation?
I read books during my vacation.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：vac 空 + ation，vacation 是空下来休息的假期。

examples.en: Let's go on a picnic this Sunday.
examples.zh: 这个星期天我们去野餐吧。

examples.en: We went on a picnic in spring.
They go on a picnic with their family.
examples.zh: 他们和家人一起去野餐。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + on a picnic 野餐，go on a picnic 是去野餐。

examples.en: Let's make a snowman in the snow.
examples.zh: 我们在雪地里堆雪人吧。

examples.en: The children make a snowman after school.
We can make a snowman when it snows.
examples.zh: 下雪时我们可以堆雪人。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：make 制作 + a snowman 雪人，make a snowman 是堆雪人。

examples.en: We pick apples in autumn.
Pick the red apples, please.
Don't pick flowers in the park.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 pick 伸手从树上 pick apples 摘苹果。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 picks；过去式 picked

examples.en: We pick apples on the farm.
Let's pick apples this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我们去摘苹果吧。

examples.en: Picking apples is hard work.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：pick 摘 + apples 苹果，pick apples 是摘苹果。

examples.en: We have a picnic in the park.
Bring food for our picnic.
The picnic was fun.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：picnic 音近「皮克尼克」，皮克尼克就是户外野餐。
形象联想：想象 picnic 草地上铺餐布、分享食物。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 picnics

examples.en: We made a big snowman.
The snowman has a carrot nose.
examples.zh: 雪人有一个胡萝卜鼻子。

examples.en: Look at our funny snowman!

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 snowman 滚雪球堆成戴帽子的雪人。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 snowmen

examples.en: I like all the seasons.
All the leaves turn yellow in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天所有的叶子都变黄了。

examples.en: We all went to see the snow.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I like all the seasons. all 是全、全部。

examples.en: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
Don't fall on the snow.
Fall is another word for autumn in America.
examples.zh: 在美国 fall 也表示秋天。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fall 秋天 leaf 从树上 fall 落下。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 falls；过去式 fell；fall 也可指【美】秋天

examples.en: A yellow leaf fell from the tree.
examples.zh: 一片黄叶从树上落下来。

examples.en: Look at this red leaf.
There is a leaf on my book.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 leaf 一片红黄相间的叶子飘落。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 leaves

examples.en: What lovely pink flowers!
examples.zh: 多么可爱的粉红花朵啊！

examples.en: We had a lovely time in the snow.
examples.zh: 我们在雪地里玩得很开心。

examples.en: The leaves look lovely in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的叶子看起来很美丽。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：lovely 音近「拉夫利」，拉夫利的一天真 lovely。
语义联想：What lovely flowers! lovely 是美丽的、可爱的。

examples.en: We paint the four seasons in art class.
examples.zh: 我们在美术课上画四季。

examples.en: She likes to paint trees and snow.
Let's paint a picture of autumn.
examples.zh: 我们画一幅秋天的画吧。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 paint 用颜料画出四季的风景。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 paints；过去式 painted

examples.en: The flowers are pink in spring.
She has a pink coat.
examples.zh: 她有一件粉红色的大衣。

examples.en: I paint the tree with pink and green.
examples.zh: 我用粉色和绿色画这棵树。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：pink 音近「品克」，品克让人想到粉红色。
语义联想：pink 表示「粉色」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: I have a few good friends at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校有几个好朋友。

examples.en: We need a few more minutes.
There are a few apples on the table.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：a 一些 + few 少数，a few 是一些、几个。

examples.en: There are a few things on my desk.
Only a few students stay after school.
examples.zh: 只有少数同学放学后留下来。

examples.en: I have a few questions about the trip.
examples.zh: 关于这次旅行我有几个问题。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There are a few things on my desk. few 是不多、少数。

examples.en: We will meet at the school gate.
Let's meet after the contest.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后我们碰面吧。

examples.en: Parents meet the teachers in September.
examples.zh: 九月份家长和老师开会。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We will meet at the gate. meet 是集会、开会、见面。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 meets；过去式 met

examples.en: We have a sports meet in October.
Are you ready for the sports meet?
examples.zh: 你准备好参加运动会了吗？

examples.en: Our class won first place at the sports meet.
examples.zh: 我们班在运动会上得了第一名。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sports 运动 + meet 集会，sports meet 是运动会。

examples.en: Pack the thing you need for the trip.
examples.zh: 把旅行需要的东西装好。

examples.en: What thing do you like best about Christmas?
There is one more thing I want to say.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Pack the things you need. thing 是东西、事情。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 things

examples.en: We have a school trip in April.
Our trip to the zoo was fun.
examples.zh: 我们去动物园的旅行很有趣。

examples.en: Don't forget your things for the trip.
examples.zh: 别忘了带旅行用的东西。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 trip 同学们背着书包去春游。

examples.en: It often rains in April.
We have a school trip in April.
April comes before May.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：april 与春天开放有关，april 是四月。

examples.en: We have an English contest in May.
She won the singing contest.
Are you ready for the contest?
examples.zh: 你准备好参加比赛了吗？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：con 共同 + test 比试，contest 是比赛、竞赛。

examples.en: February comes after January.
We go back to school in February.
February is a short month.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：febru 净化 + ary，february 是二月。

examples.en: Winter vacation is usually in January.
January is the first month of the year.
examples.zh: 一月是一年的第一个月。

examples.en: It is cold in January.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Janus 罗马门神，january 是一月、新的一年开始。

examples.en: Children's Day is in June.
School ends in June.
June is hot and sunny.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：june 与 Juno 女神有关，june 是六月。

examples.en: May Day is also called Labour Day.
People rest on Labour Day.
We learn about Labour Day in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上了解劳动节。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：labour 即 labor 劳动，labour 是劳动；Labour Day 是劳动节。

examples.en: Labour Day is on May first.
We don't go to school on Labour Day.
My family goes on a trip on Labour Day.
examples.zh: 劳动节我们全家去旅行。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：labour 劳动 + Day 日，Labour Day 是劳动节。

examples.en: Spring starts in March.
We plant trees in March.
March is my birthday month.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：march 本义行进，march 是三月。

examples.en: May Day is on the first of May.
The weather is warm in May.
We have a singing contest in May.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：May 音近「梅」，五月正是梅花开放的时节。
语义联想：May Day is on the first of May. May 是五月。

examples.en: We plant trees on Tree Planting Day.
Let's plant flowers in March.
The students plant ten trees last year.
examples.zh: 学生们去年种了十棵树。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 plant 把小树苗种进春天的土里。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 plants；过去式 planted

examples.en: There are twelve months in a year.
Happy new year!
This year we have a singing contest in May.
examples.zh: 今年我们五月有歌咏比赛。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There are twelve months in a year. year 是年、年份。

examples.en: We visited the Great Wall last year.
The Great Wall is very long.
Many tourists visit the Great Wall.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：the Great Wall 专有名词，the Great Wall 是长城。

examples.en: Thanksgiving is an American holiday.
My friend has an American pen pal.
examples.zh: 我的朋友有一位美国笔友。

examples.en: We learn about American festivals in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上了解美国节日。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：America 美国 + n，American 是美国的；美国人。

examples.en: We travel in August.
August is the last month of summer vacation.
examples.zh: 八月是暑假的最后一个月。

examples.en: My birthday is in August.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：august 来自 Augustus，august 是八月。

examples.en: Christmas is on the twenty-fifth of December.
examples.zh: 圣诞节在十二月二十五日。

examples.en: We sing songs at Christmas.
Children love Christmas.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Christ 基督 + mas 弥撒，Christmas 是圣诞节。

examples.en: Christmas is in December.
December is the last month of the year.
examples.zh: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

examples.en: It is cold in December.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：dec 十 + ember，december 是十二月。

examples.en: Summer vacation starts in July.
It is very hot in July.
We visit my grandparents in July.
examples.zh: 我们七月去看望祖父母。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：July 来自 Julius Caesar，july 是七月。

examples.en: National Day is a special holiday.
examples.zh: 国庆节是一个特别的节日。

examples.en: We watch the national flag on National Day.
It is a national holiday in October.
examples.zh: 这是十月的全国性假日。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：nation 国家 + al，national 是国家的。

examples.en: National Day is on October first.
We watch fireworks on National Day.
Happy National Day!

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：national 国家的 + Day 日，National Day 是国庆节。

examples.en: Thanksgiving is in November in America.
examples.zh: 在美国感恩节在十一月。

examples.en: It gets cold in November.
We have a few things to do in November.
examples.zh: 十一月我们有几件事要做。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：novem 九 + ber，november 是十一月（古罗马历第九月）。

examples.en: National Day is in October.
The weather is cool in October.
We have a sports meet in October.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：oct 八 + ember，october 是十月。

examples.en: School starts again in September.
September is the first month of autumn.
examples.zh: 九月是秋天的第一个月。

examples.en: Teachers' Day is in September.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sept 七 + ember，september 是九月。

examples.en: Thanksgiving is in November in America.
examples.zh: 在美国感恩节在十一月。

examples.en: Families get together on Thanksgiving.
We talk about Thanksgiving in our English class.
examples.zh: 我们在英语课上讲感恩节。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：thanks 感谢 + giving 给予，Thanksgiving 是感恩节。

examples.en: The children act out a story.
We act in a play for Christmas.
examples.zh: 我们为圣诞节排演一出戏。

examples.en: She likes to act on stage.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The children act out a story. act 是扮演、表演。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 acts；过去式 acted

examples.en: Let's act out the story in groups.
examples.zh: 我们分组把故事表演出来吧。

examples.en: The students act out a play in class.
examples.zh: 学生们在课上表演一出短剧。

examples.en: Can you act out this dialogue?
examples.zh: 你能把这段对话表演出来吗？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：act 表演 + out 出来，act out 是把……表演出来。

examples.en: We finish the work by Friday.
examples.zh: 我们星期五之前完成这项工作。

examples.en: The show is over by six o'clock.
I read the letter by myself.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：by 音近「拜」，by Friday 是「拜五之前」。
语义联想：by 表示「在……之前」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: Let's play a word game.
examples.zh: 我们来玩一个单词游戏吧。

examples.en: We played a riddle game in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上玩了猜谜游戏。

examples.en: The game was fun.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：game 音近「盖姆」，盖姆就是游戏 game。
语义联想：Let's play a word game. game 是游戏、比赛。

examples.en: Can you answer this riddle?
We ask a riddle at the party.
This riddle is about an animal.
examples.zh: 这个谜语是关于一种动物的。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 riddle 猜谜语时挠头想答案。

examples.en: Please RSVP by Friday.
examples.zh: 请在星期五之前回复是否参加。

examples.en: The invitation says RSVP.
Don't forget to RSVP to the party.
examples.zh: 别忘了回复是否参加聚会。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：RSVP 来自法语 Répondez s'il vous plaît，意为请赐复。

examples.en: The Spring Festival is my favourite festival.
examples.zh: 春节是我最喜欢的节日。

examples.en: We learn about a different festival.
Every festival has special food.
examples.zh: 每个节日都有特别的食物。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：fest 节日 + ival，festival 是节日。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 festivals

examples.en: Some festivals are special; other festivals are fun too.
examples.zh: 有些节日很特别，其他节日也很有趣。

examples.en: I like this show and the other one.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这个展览，也喜欢另一个。

examples.en: Ask other students about the festival.
examples.zh: 向其他同学问问这个节日。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Some festivals are special; other festivals are fun too. other 是其他。

examples.en: We visit an art show at the museum.
examples.zh: 我们参观博物馆里的美术展览。

examples.en: There is a photo show in our school.
examples.zh: 我们学校有一个摄影展。

examples.en: Show me your new book, please.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 show 美术馆里挂着一排排画作展览。

examples.en: Mid-Autumn Festival is a special day.
examples.zh: 中秋节是一个特别的日子。

examples.en: We have a special show at school.
examples.zh: 我们在学校有一个特别的展览。

examples.en: This is a special gift for you.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：spec 特别 + ial，special 是特别的。

examples.en: May is the fifth month of the year.
examples.zh: 五月是一年的第五个月。

examples.en: Her birthday is on the fifth of June.
This is my fifth diary.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：fifth 第五，(5th) 是 fifth 的缩写。

reveal.inflectionNote: 序数词；缩写 5th = fifth

examples.en: January is the first month of the year.
examples.zh: 一月是一年的第一个月。

examples.en: She finished first in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第一名。

examples.en: The first of May is Labour Day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：first 第一，(1st) 是 first 的缩写。

reveal.inflectionNote: 序数词；缩写 1st = first

examples.en: April is the fourth month.
The fourth student is Tom.
We have English on the fourth day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：fourth 第四，(4th) 是 fourth 的缩写。

reveal.inflectionNote: 序数词；缩写 4th = fourth

examples.en: February is the second month.
Wait a second, please.
He came second in the contest.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中得了第二名。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：second 第二，(2nd) 是 second 的缩写。

reveal.inflectionNote: 序数词；缩写 2nd = second

examples.en: March is the third month of the year.
examples.zh: 三月是一年的第三个月。

examples.en: Today is the third of April.
She lives on the third floor.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：third 第三，(3rd) 是 third 的缩写。

reveal.inflectionNote: 序数词；缩写 3rd = third

examples.en: Today is the thirtieth of November.
June has thirty days, and today is the thirtieth.
examples.zh: 六月有三十天，今天是三十日。

examples.en: The thirtieth student is very tall.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：thirty 三十变 thirtieth，(30th) 是第三十。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 thirty 变来；缩写 30th

examples.en: December is the twelfth month.
Today is the twelfth of March.
She is in the twelfth grade.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：twelve 十二变 twelfth，(12th) 是第十二。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 twelve 变来；缩写 12th

examples.en: Today is the twentieth of January.
The twentieth student raised his hand.
We have a test on the twentieth.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：twenty 二十变 twentieth，(20th) 是第二十。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 twenty 变来；缩写 20th

examples.en: My birthday is on the twenty-first of August.
examples.zh: 我的生日在八月二十一日。

examples.en: The twenty-first page is about festivals.
examples.zh: 第二十一页讲的是节日。

examples.en: She came twenty-first in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第二十一名。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：twenty-one 二十一变 twenty-first，(21st) 是第二十一。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 twenty-one 变来；缩写 21st

examples.en: Today is the twenty-third of May.
The twenty-third question is easy.
We leave on the twenty-third.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：twenty-three 二十三变 twenty-third，(23rd) 是第二十三。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 twenty-three 变来；缩写 23rd

examples.en: I write in my diary every day.
She wrote about the festival in her diary.
examples.zh: 她在日记里写了这个节日。

examples.en: Don't read my diary, please.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：di 日 + ary，diary 是日记、日记本。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 diaries

examples.en: The kitten's fur is very soft.
Brown fur covers the dog.
examples.zh: 棕色的毛覆盖着那只狗。

examples.en: She touched the fur gently.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fur 音近「佛儿」，软 fur 像佛儿身上柔软的毛。
形象联想：想象 fur 小猫身上柔软细密的毛。

examples.en: The kitten has soft white fur.
examples.zh: 这只小猫有柔软的白毛。

examples.en: Look at the cute kitten in the show.
examples.zh: 看展览里那只可爱的小猫。

examples.en: The kitten makes a little noise.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 kitten 一只毛茸茸的小猫在玩耍。

examples.en: Don't make so much noise.
I heard a noise outside.
The festival was full of music and noise.
examples.zh: 节日里满是音乐和喧闹声。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 noise 节日里鞭炮和音乐混在一起。

examples.en: The museum is open from nine to five.
examples.zh: 博物馆九点到五点开放。

examples.en: Is the show still open today?
The shop is open on Sunday.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The show is open today. open 是开放的、营业的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 opens；过去式 opened

examples.en: It is still open. We can go in.
examples.zh: 还开着门，我们可以进去。

examples.en: Please stand still for the photo.
The kitten is still sleeping.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The museum is still open. still 是仍然、还；静止的。

examples.en: We walk to the art show.
examples.zh: 我们步行去看美术展览。

examples.en: Let's take a walk after dinner.
The kitten can walk now.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 walk 晚饭后在展览馆外散步。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 walks；过去式 walked

examples.en: The pink coat is hers.
examples.zh: 这件粉红色大衣是她的。

examples.en: This diary is hers.
Is the kitten hers?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The pink coat is hers. hers 是她的。

examples.en: This is his book.
His dog is sleeping.
The ball is his.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This is his book. his 是他的。

examples.en: This book is mine.
The red bag is mine, not yours.
examples.zh: 红书包是我的，不是你的。

examples.en: Is this seat mine?

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 mine 用手指指「这是我的」。

examples.en: This classroom is ours.
The contest prize is ours.
Ours is the team on the left.
examples.zh: 左边那支队伍是我们的。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This classroom is ours. ours 是我们的。

examples.en: The big house is theirs.
These seats are theirs.
The art show is theirs.
examples.zh: 这个美术展览是他们的。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The big house is theirs. theirs 是他们的。

examples.en: Is this pen yours?
My bag is blue. Yours is pink.
examples.zh: 我的包是蓝色的，你的是粉红色的。

examples.en: This seat is yours.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Is this pen yours? yours 是你的。

examples.en: Look! The panda is climbing the tree.
The cat is climbing up the wall.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：climb 爬 + ing，climbing 是正在攀爬。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 climb；climbing 表示正在攀爬

examples.en: The cat is drinking water.
He is drinking tea after dinner.
Don't talk while you are drinking.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：drink 喝 + ing，drinking 是正在喝。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 drink；drinking 表示正在喝

examples.en: Each student has a book.
We give each other a gift at Christmas.
Each day we write in our diary.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Each student has a book. each 是每个、各自。

examples.en: We help each other at school.
They give each other gifts at Christmas.
The two friends talk to each other every day.
examples.zh: 两个朋友每天互相交谈。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：each 每个 + other 其他，each other 是互相、彼此。

examples.en: Look! The panda is eating bamboo.
Don't talk while you are eating.
The cat is eating fish.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：eating 吃 + ing，eating 是正在吃。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 eat；eating 表示正在吃

examples.en: Look! The rabbit is jumping.
The dog is jumping over the fence.
She is jumping rope in the playground.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：jump 跳 + ing，jumping 是正在跳。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 jump；jumping 表示正在跳

examples.en: The children are playing in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

examples.en: He is playing football after school.
Stop playing and do your homework.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：play 玩 + ing，playing 是正在玩耍。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 play；playing 表示正在玩耍

examples.en: The kitten is sleeping on the sofa.
Be quiet. The baby is sleeping.
My dog is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 我的狗在桌子底下睡觉。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sleep 睡 + ing，sleeping 是正在睡觉。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 sleep；sleeping 表示正在睡觉

examples.en: We are excited about the school trip.
examples.zh: 我们对学校旅行很兴奋。

examples.en: The children are excited on Children's Day.
examples.zh: 孩子们在儿童节很激动。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We are excited about the trip. excited 是兴奋的、激动的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 由 excite 变化而来；比较级 more excited

examples.en: He looks like his father.
It's raining. I feel like staying at home.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He looks like his father. like 这里表示像……那样。

examples.en: Pandas eat bamboo.
Bamboo grows very fast.
There is green bamboo in the photo.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：bamboo 双音叠词像竹子节节生长，bamboo 是竹子。

examples.en: The panda is eating its bamboo.
The kitten washed its fur.
The dog wagged its tail.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The panda is eating its bamboo. its 是它的。

examples.en: They are doing morning exercises in the playground.
examples.zh: 他们正在操场上做早操。

examples.en: We like doing morning exercises every day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：do morning exercises 的 -ing 形式，正在做早操。

reveal.inflectionNote: 原形 do morning exercises

examples.en: They are eating lunch in the canteen.
Don't talk when you are eating lunch.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：eating 正在吃 + lunch 午餐，eating lunch 是正在吃午饭。

examples.en: We are having an English class now.
examples.zh: 我们现在正在上英语课。

examples.en: She is having a maths class.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：having 正在 + class 课，having … class 是正在上课。

examples.en: She is listening to music.
Talk quietly when others are listening to music.
examples.zh: 别人听音乐时要小声说话。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：listening 正在听 + music 音乐，listening to music 是正在听音乐。

examples.en: He is reading a book quietly.
I like reading a book before bed.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：reading 正在读 + a book 书，reading a book 是正在看书。

examples.en: Do you need anything else?
You can ask me anything.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do you need anything else? anything 是任何事物。

examples.en: What else do you do on weekends?
Anything else?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What else do you do? else 是另外、其他。

examples.en: Keep quiet in the library.
We keep our classroom clean.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Keep quiet in the library. keep 是保持某种状态。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 keeps；过去式 kept

examples.en: Keep to the right in the hallway.
Please keep to the right when you walk upstairs.
We keep to the right at school.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：keep 保持 + to the right 靠右，keep to the right 是靠右行走。

examples.en: Keep your desk clean, please.
I keep my desk clean every day.
examples.zh: 我每天都保持课桌干净。

examples.en: The teacher asks us to keep our desks clean.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们保持课桌干净。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：keep 保持 + your desk clean 课桌干净，keep your desk clean 是保持课桌整洁。

examples.en: Take turns to answer the question.
We take turns to clean the classroom.
Let's take turns to read the story.
examples.zh: 我们轮流读这个故事吧。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：take 轮流 + turns 次/轮，take turns 是按顺序来、轮流。

examples.en: Talk quietly in the library.
Please talk quietly in class.
We talk quietly when others are working.
examples.zh: 别人做事时我们小声说话。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：talk 说话 + quietly 小声地，talk quietly 是小声讲话。

examples.en: Wait your turn, please.
It is your turn to answer.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wait your turn. turn 可指顺序、轮流。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 turns；过去式 turned

examples.en: He has a Canadian friend.
This is a Canadian map.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He has a Canadian friend. Canadian 是加拿大的。

examples.en: There is a photo exhibition at school.
We visit the art exhibition in the museum.
examples.zh: 我们参观博物馆里的美术展。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There is a photo exhibition. exhibition 是展览。

examples.en: Have a look at this photo.
Can I have a look at your diary?
examples.zh: 我能看一看你的日记吗？

examples.en: Come and have a look at the pandas.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：have 进行 + a look 看一看，have a look 是看一看。

examples.en: Please say it again.
What did you say?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Please say it again. say 是说、讲。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 says；过去式 said

examples.en: She speaks Spanish.
We learn about Spanish festivals.
examples.zh: 我们了解西班牙的节日。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She speaks Spanish. Spanish 是西班牙的。

examples.en: Sure, I can help you.
Are you coming? — Sure!

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Sure, I can help you. sure 表示当然、好的。

examples.en: I like sushi very much.
We eat sushi in the restaurant.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I like sushi. sushi 是寿司。

examples.en: My mother can teach English.
Can you teach me this word?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My mother teaches English. teach 是教。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 teaches；过去式 taught
